samples.summary: `r.canManage` is truthy-gated with no fallback, so any response missing the field hides every "Details" link
samples.evidence: `{r.canManage && (<Link .../>)}` — the field is brand new on the API response. During a rolling deploy (new frontend + old backend), or for a `WorkspaceAnalytics` payload cached by react-query/persisted from before this change, `canManage` is `undefined` and the ranking silently renders zero drill-in links even for the workspace owner. The backend enrichment at analytics.controller.ts:245 is the only producer; a fail-open fallback (e.g. `r.canManage !== false`) or a version-tolerant default would avoid the regression, at the cost of a 403 for the old-backend case that the page now explains anyway (document-analytics.tsx:60).

samples.summary: `canManage` is computed from workspace membership only; a non-member document author would be told `false` while the detail endpoint would let them in
samples.evidence: The roll-up computes `isDocumentManager(member.role, d?.authorID ?? null, userId)` where `member` comes from `assertMember`, but the detail endpoint (line 167-174) looks up membership independently and `isDocumentManager` returns true on `authorID === userId` even with `membership === undefined`. Within one workspace the two agree in practice (an author of a workspace doc who has been removed from the workspace can no longer reach the roll-up at all, since `assertMember` throws first), so the divergence is unreachable today — flagging as a latent inconsistency between the two gates rather than a live bug.

samples.summary: An empty-string document title now falls through to the title, not the documentId, only because `??` is used — behavior unchanged but the warehouse placeholder is `''`
samples.evidence: `title: d?.title ?? r.documentId` keeps the previous `titles.get(...) ?? r.documentId` semantics, so a document row whose Postgres `title` is `''` renders as an empty title. The frontend compensates with `{r.title || r.documentId}` (workspace-analytics.tsx:83), so no user-visible break; noted for completeness since the mapping was rewritten in this diff.
